title: feat(specs): add playground
body:
goal of this is to replace storybook at term, once it's all working as we expect.

What's currently done:

An example done for Breadcrumb using Sandpack for all flavours, using local build to get the package contents

![Screenshot 2023-12-26 at 17 45 37](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/assets/6270048/81a431cc-db5b-4b68-a187-9db95d8f62e3)


What still coud be done:

- Maybe tabs for the examples
- actually differentiate between "focused widget" and the regular app
- Maybe "full screen mode"
- Maybe see if the "open in sandbox" could be made working again (times out now because too many files I believe)
- See if we really need only one example per widget, otherwise design for multiple examples
